info.title: VoltLink API
info.description: Generated from the live route table and the shared zod schemas. Auth is a session cookie (`vl_session`) plus a CSRF header (`x-vl-csrf`) for mutating requests.

post.summary: Register an account (first-run setup or invitation/open mode)

post.description: Creates a command with the given type and parameters for the vehicle. Valid types: wake, lock, unlock, climate_start, climate_stop, set_temperature, defrost, seat_heater, steering_heater, charge_start, charge_stop, set_charge_limit, set_charging_amps, charge_port_open, charge_port_close, open_trunk, open_frunk, window_vent, window_close, sentry_mode, flash_lights, honk_horn, homelink, remote_start, valet_mode, speed_limit, send_navigation, schedule_update, cancel_update.

get.summary: List vehicles visible to the actor

post.summary: Issue a command to a vehicle (per-vehicle alias)
post.description: Equivalent to POST /api/v1/commands with the vehicleId in the path.

csrfHeader.name: x-vl-csrf
csrfHeader.description: CSRF token for mutating requests, issued by /api/v1/auth/csrf.

bearerApiKey.description: API key bearer token (keys start with vlk_).
